notes.title: AWITT - Chapter Two
notes.notes:
After much work, here we are finally at Chapter Two of AWITT.
As anticipated, this Chapter will be more focused on the plot and characters. Compared to Chapter One, I can say that it will be easier to finish... but it will be much more immersive.

AWITT is an embracing gaming experience, and this will be its final narrative form through which this story will be told... and experienced by you firsthand.

NOTE FOR MAC USERS:
According to the testers (and from my personal experience, I am a Mac user), the first launch of the game will take a few minutes depending on your operating system. Just be patient, I tried to optimize the game as best as I could.
From the second launch onwards the game will start immediately.

If you encounter any problems, don't hesitate to write here:
inorganicvisions@gmail.com

Thanks for being here.
I hope Zory and the mysterious moon Hippalectryon can give you a wonderful journey.

Max Rudy Magni - Game Designer
